name: MagneticDock
description: Developer launcher dock with smooth Gaussian proximity magnification, non-clipping headroom padding, tooltips, and Left/Right arrow keyboard navigation.
a11yNotes: Renders a semantic <nav> with Left/Right arrow key focus cycling, accessible aria-label on every dock button, and overflow-visible headroom so magnified items never clip.

propsApi.name: maxScale
propsApi.description: Peak magnification multiplier under the pointer.
